articles.title: Treasury's Bessent sees crypto as America's next tool for keeping the U.S. dollar on top
articles.snippet: Speaking at Ripple's conference, the U.S. Treasury Secretary said the SEC and CFTC action could help fill the gap left by the Clarity Act's failure, while curbing crypto debanking.

articles.title: Crypto PAC spending before midterms possibly obscured after reported FEC hack
articles.snippet: The FEC reported an “electronic filing system outage” on Tuesday as groups are expected to ramp up spending before the US midterm elections.

articles.title: CFTC sues Utah to block action against prediction markets
articles.snippet: The US state filed a lawsuit against Kalshi last week, seeking to recover up to $60 million in profits related to event contracts on prediction markets.
